# Reporting defaults

These are framework candidates, not project findings. Configure may apply a candidate only after discovery and confirmation, marking it `★` with a date. Project conventions take precedence.

## Audiences

No default audience list. Identify intended readers from the request and project context.

## Formats

Candidate working format: Markdown. Convert to a provider-specific format only in the provider layer and only when publishing is approved.

## Channel templates

No channel-specific template default. Discover the project’s approved templates and preserve their required headings.

## Tech-report defaults

Use the requested report mode and evidence available. `git log` is mandatory for commit-based reports; if there are no commits, stop and report that fact. Do not infer causality or compute unsupported metrics.

## File naming

Candidate working location: `qa-work/<work-id>/outputs/`. Follow the skill’s defined filename and any confirmed project naming convention. Do not claim a file has been published because it exists locally.

## Documentation

| Field | Candidate |
|---|---|
| Docs root | Discover; no default. |
| Index page | Discover; no default. |
| Home page | Discover; no default. |
| Glossary | Discover; no default. |

For documentation analysis use index-first reading when an index exists. For changes, use the project’s documented docs root and preview/publish gates.
